title: Clefts & fronting
note: It-cleft / wh-cleft / the reason why / all… · fronting · emphatic do · thin shell 2026-08-06 · pairs with inversion unit

cards.title: Put the news where the reader looks
cards.title_cz: Dejte informaci tam, kam se čtenář dívá
cards.body: **Clefts** package one piece of information as the focus (*It was… that…*, *What… is…*). **Fronting** moves an object/adverbial first. **Emphatic do** stresses the verb. Together they shape information structure — not new facts, better packaging.
cards.body_cz: **Clefts** zdůrazní jednu informaci. **Fronting** posune prvek na začátek. **Emphatic do** zdůrazní sloveso. Jde o strukturu informace.

items.en: It was Maria who called you.
items.cz: Byla to Maria, kdo ti volal.
accepts: It was Maria who called you.
items.explanation: It-cleft for focus on the person.

items.en: What I need is a quiet room.
items.gap: What I need ____ a quiet room.
accepts: What I need is a quiet room.

items.en: The reason why she left was the noise.
items.gap: The reason why she left ____ the noise.
accepts: The reason why she left was the noise.

items.en: All I want is an honest answer.
items.cz: Jediné, co chci, je upřímná odpověď.
items.gap: All I want ____ an honest answer.
accepts: All I want is an honest answer.

items.en: This book I finished in two days.
items.cz: Tuhle knihu jsem dočetl za dva dny.
items.gap: This book I ____ in two days.
accepts: This book I finished in two days.

items.en: Never again will I ignore a warning like that.
items.cz: Už nikdy nebudu ignorovat takové varování.
items.gap: Never again ____ I ignore a warning like that.
accepts: Never again will I ignore a warning like that.
items.explanation: Edge: fronted negative time → inversion (also in inversion unit).
items.explanation_cz: Zápor vepředu → inverze (i v unit inversion).

items.en: It was in Prague that we first met.
items.cz: Bylo to v Praze, kde jsme se poprvé potkali.
items.gap: It was in Prague ____ we first met.
accepts: It was in Prague that we first met.

items.cz: To, co se stalo dál, bylo neočekávané.

items.en: Only then did she realise the mistake.
items.gap: Only then ____ she realise the mistake.
accepts: Only then did she realise the mistake.
items.explanation: Only then + inversion (bridge to inversion unit).
